password_reset.subject: Reset your PrimeCare password
password_reset.title: Password reset
password_reset.body: Use this one-time code in the PrimeCare app: {{code}}. It expires in 15 minutes. If you did not request this, ignore this email.

welcome.subject: Welcome to PrimeCare
welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.body: Hello {{name}}, your PrimeCare account is ready. Sign in using your organization's approved app.

account_invitation.subject: Your PrimeCare invitation
account_invitation.title: Account invitation
account_invitation.body: Hello {{name}}, contact {{support}} to complete your account setup. Never send your password by email.

appointment_confirmation.subject: PrimeCare appointment confirmation
appointment_confirmation.title: Appointment confirmed
appointment_confirmation.body: Your appointment is scheduled for {{date}} at {{location}}. Contact {{support}} if you need help.

appointment_cancellation.subject: PrimeCare appointment cancelled
appointment_cancellation.title: Appointment cancelled
appointment_cancellation.body: Your appointment on {{date}} has been cancelled. Contact {{support}} to reschedule.

payment_receipt.subject: PrimeCare payment receipt
payment_receipt.title: Payment received
payment_receipt.body: Payment of {{amount}} was received. Receipt reference: {{reference}}.

security_notice.subject: PrimeCare security notice
security_notice.title: Account security
security_notice.body: {{message}} If you did not make this change, contact {{support}}.
